_comment: Fragment 26 — D-69, G64 specified: inference limb withdrawn, G-02 Data Source limb stands, C-16 opened. Merged 2026-08-21.

nodes.label: D-69 — G64 Specified, Not Applied
nodes.description: G64 moves to specified-not-applied, the disposition R3 carries under D-56 and X4 under D-61. Two candidate shapes are set out with their consequences — a three-valued line_separation enum, or a boolean plus event_type — and the choice is left with Q11, where D-68 placed it one pass earlier. No field name, field shape, or enum value is decided.
nodes.rationale: G64's resolution is a shape choice, and a shape choice is Q11's substance. Specifying removes the defect from the critical path without reversing a decision the Chief Editor had just made. The three-valued shape is recorded as the specification's recommendation because it needs one fewer Modular_PRD amendment and uses the vocabulary the documents already speak.

nodes.label: G64's NFR-03 Inference Limb Is Withdrawn
nodes.description: As opened, G64 rested on two limbs. The claim that NFR-03 forbids inference at read does not survive inspection: the phrase is undefined anywhere in the corpus, NFR-03's measurable target is 100 percent non-null with method column constraint, which a boolean satisfies, and G-03 already computes its metric directly from a stored event_type — so these documents do not treat reading a stored column as inference.
nodes.rationale: A violation was asserted against an undefined term, and against a requirement whose measured target the disputed shape actually meets. CLAUDE.md carries the standing rule to check what an unfamiliar label maps to before recording an incompatibility; three prior conflicts were vocabulary rather than structure, and this is the fourth.

nodes.label: A Conflict Asserted Past What the Source Says
nodes.description: The mirror image of summary_outlived_source. Rather than a derived restatement still asserting what its source no longer supports, this is a derived finding asserting more than its source ever supported. Both produce a document that cannot be checked against the thing it claims to describe.
nodes.rationale: Recorded as a distinct direction of the same failure because the countermeasures differ. Summary drift is caught by re-reading the source; overreach is caught by asking whether the source defines the term the finding leans on. Here it did not, and nothing in the finding's own shape signalled that.

nodes.label: G-02 Cannot Be Computed From Its Own Data Source
nodes.description: G-02's Data Source column names one field and states it becomes line_boundary_crossed if the rename is confirmed. Its definition counts T5 and T6 crossings without Line separation while excluding logged overrides, which requires not_applicable and override_not_four_eyes to be told apart. A boolean maps both to false, so under a boolean shape the metric needs a second column its own Data Source does not name.
nodes.rationale: This is the limb of G64 that survives, and it holds regardless of what inferred at read means — it is arithmetic on the declared columns rather than an interpretation. Under a three-valued shape the Data Source needs no amendment at all.

nodes.label: C-16 — inferred at read Is Undefined and Measured by Nothing
nodes.description: The phrase appears five times across docs and is defined nowhere. NFR-03's Target is 100 percent non-null and its Method is a column constraint, so the clause is measured by nothing. The rewrite Q11 already requires must define the clause or drop it. Follow-up phase: the Q11 decision, before the S0 draft of 0002.
nodes.rationale: An undefined term in a governing requirement is unfalsifiable — it can be neither satisfied nor breached — and it invites exactly the overreach that G64's withdrawn limb recorded. Carried as a condition rather than a gap because it attaches to an NFR-03 rewrite that is already required rather than creating new work.
